rationale: Builds directly on the current late-aligned decoder-skip winner, but spends the remaining byte headroom on the exact path that now matters more: both recurrent tail blocks receive direct late decoder context, so keeping each block's QKV matrices float-kept should preserve that repeated tail computation through the final int8+zlib roundtrip more faithfully than rescuing only QK plus the last V. This is a compact tail float-budget reallocation, not a new side head or a replayed LR sweep, and it also removes the old special-case final-block V rule as unused complexity.
title: Late-Skip Tail QKV Float Rescue
